test_title: PYST 27: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the (bracketed) part of the sentence. In case of no improvement select the option 'No improvement'.

Check all radiators for (meagre leaks, special) round pipework connections.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option to improve the bracketed part of the sentence, **"meagre leaks, special," **is: **'small leaks, especially'**
 
• The term** "meagre leaks"** is not commonly used and can be confusing.** "Small leaks" **is a more appropriate term to use in this context.
 
• Also, the adverb** "especially"** is the correct word to use here because it emphasizes that particular attention should be given to the "pipework connections."

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'Check all radiators for **small leaks, especially** round pipework connections.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Modest leaks"** (option 3) could also be understood, but it's less clear and precise than** "small leaks."**
 
• The word** "specially"** (options 3 and 4) is not incorrect per se, but **"especially"** is the more appropriate choice in this context because it is used to indicate something as a special case.
 
• **"Cramped leaks"** (option 4) does not make sense in this context as **"cramped"** refers to a lack of space and can't describe a leak.
